home.none: No sessions yet. Press Talk and say hello.
talk.title: Talk
talk.mode.daily.sub: Small talk with a West Coast colleague
talk.mode.mywork.sub: Your real project, as a scenario
talk.mywork.label: Describe your project (1–3 lines, English or Japanese)
talk.mywork.placeholder: e.g. Conveyor line for an Ohio plant. 2 PLCs, 6 VFDs, HMI. Customer wants FAT next month but the drives are late.
talk.mic.denied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in the address bar and reload.
talk.unsupported: Speech recognition isn't available in this browser. Use Chrome or Edge on PC.
talk.noToken: Set the app token in Settings first.
talk.hint.stuck: Keep going — you can say it simply.
summary.title: Session complete
summary.queued: Saved locally — will sync when online
progress.title: Progress
settings.title: Settings
settings.token.help: Same value as APP_TOKEN on the Worker. Stored only in this browser.
settings.token.noKey: Connected, but ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is missing on the Worker
settings.immersion.high: High — English only, Japanese is answered in English
settings.immersion.medium: Medium — Japanese words are given in English
settings.immersion.low: Low — Japanese sentences are translated first
settings.wipe.confirm: Delete ALL sessions and stats from the server? This cannot be undone.
settings.token.keyInvalid: Connected, but Anthropic rejected the API key ({hint}). Re-create it at console.anthropic.com → API Keys, paste it into .dev.vars with no quotes or spaces, then restart npm run dev.
settings.token.keyError: Connected, but the Anthropic API returned an error: {msg}
settings.micMode.auto: Auto (always on for PC, tap to talk on iPhone)
settings.sttEngine.help: Server mode needs STT_API_KEY on the Worker. Use it if Safari's recognition is unreliable.
settings.sttEngine.missing: Server speech-to-text is not configured on the Worker (STT_API_KEY).
settings.token.keyWorkspace: Connected, but this API key is not tied to a workspace (sk-ant-usr-… keys). Either add ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID=<workspace id> to .dev.vars (Console → Settings → Workspaces) and restart, or create a key inside a workspace (Console → Workspaces → your workspace → API Keys).
